definitions.selection: Largest consistently passing sampled offered rate, confirmed in three fresh 60-second processes. It is not an exact sustainable-load ceiling or paired-long retuning.
definitions.search: Original finite ladder, doubling if needed, bisection to initial bracket width at most 10% of passing rate, then three confirmations; failed confirmation steps down by 10% and reconfirms. Final stepped-down bracket may exceed 10%.
definitions.generator: Generator or environment invalidity cannot establish a server-capacity upper bound. Invalid and failed points remain recorded.
definitions.successes: Controller successes/throughput include correctly completed expected cancellation/deadline probes. Business successes/throughput exclude those probes.
definitions.outcomes: Controller cancelled/rejected/failed outcomes are distinct from successful intentional probes, which complete with ok and are counted separately by the independent client.
definitions.p99: Original aggregate arrival-success p99 includes successful expected probes; this is not the ordinary-scenario p99 or a pooled comparison aggregate.
definitions.resources: Whole profile sampled resources. CPU percent is of one core. GC bytes are sampled and cannot be assigned to individual RPCs.
definitions.exits: Controller cell exit_code/run_exit_code and the result producer exit_code are retained separately.
definitions.scope: No direct Rust capacity search was performed in this weak-cache comparison; fixed-load direct Rust numbers are in comparison.json.

invalid_ON_240_confirmation_2.interpretation: The concrete correctness failure is a cancellation probe whose wait headers were not committed; the generic response/protobuf/hash label does not demonstrate payload corruption. Drain also failed with TimeoutError and outstanding retirement/native payload. Causality and whether OFF shares the path remain unresolved here.
